About Tanks of Freedom

Classic turn-based strategy game with two armies fighting against each other. Challenge yourself in campaign against AI or hot-seat battle with a friend. Using easy map editor you can create any imaginable scenario to play (and share online for others to discover - not yet implemented).

Platforms: Linux, OSX, Windows, Android Price: free Sources: open (MIT)

Gameplay

Test the game yourself by downloading from itch.io (http://w84death.itch.io/tanks-of-freedom)).

Or watch gameplay by AC-Gamer https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IcChSYmB7GM

Our plans

The game is not finished. It need some changes to make it easier for first players and in the same time add more strategy for dedicated players. That’s why we’re asking community for help.

Here are some things that will change. If you feel that the change will be bad or know how to do it better - please comment. Each idea is welcome.

3.1 Pricing/action points will be reevaluated. And the new movement mechanics will eat only few action points per unit.

It will work like this: Unit have N action slots. E.g. soldier will have 2. Each action slot can be used for one of those: - movement (to the max unit range) - attack* (attack any unit in range) - taking* building * - this will block all other action slots. So soldier can move twice, move and attack or just attack.

3.2 Barracks will produce cheaper soldier. But also will have other units and it will be the only place to research soldiers upgrades. Main base will still produce base unit (soldier) for emergency situations.

Comment by AC-Gamer: "I like the idea of researching soldier upgrades and even new and improved units but would love to see key places on the map, perhaps resources or even buildings such as science or civil buildings needed for certain upgrades. I think this would again help drive the combat early on and even promote exploration into some far corner of the map that would normally go over looked, allowing you the chance to make larger and more elongated maps then before."

3.3 Each building have a Spawn Tile - the place where new units will appear. And if this spot is taken, you can not build new unit. I was thinking of making it as in Quake (“telefrag”). So new unit is killing anything in that spot (also own units). But as it turns out blocking ability to build was quite a fun and it’s a nice strategy to piss off enemy :) That’s why we decide to leave it as it is.

3.4 Now only base units (soldiers) can take buildings. Idea for the future: other units can make buildings unoccupied again but will be destroyed (think of it as sacrifice).

3.5 Some new units. Mock-up: http://i.imgur.com/acOEHib.png We are thinking of two units per building (Barracks, Factory, Airport). And some sort of air strike/nuke that will be "build" in the HQ.

3.6 Sharing custom-maps in the cloud. Each map made in our editor will have option to share with others. But to prevent of uploading unplayable maps we need to make some self-test. I was thinking off this: each new map created by player can be uploaded only if he wins this map.

p.s. I also post this at reddit and I'm very curious off the both communities :D
